status_vocabulary.Supported: An official or native mechanism exists and the Harness behavior is verified.
status_vocabulary.Mechanism verified: Harness package, adapter, or installer checks pass, but a real host run is not confirmed.
status_vocabulary.Live verified: A real host session or portal operation produced preserved evidence.
status_vocabulary.Partial: Only part of the capability is available or verified.
status_vocabulary.Unsupported: The host explicitly does not provide the required mechanism.
status_vocabulary.Unknown: The capability was not verified or the official documentation does not establish it.
